newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries reverse pre-FOMC gains,close at lows.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries reverse pre-FOMC gains,close at lows.

text.p: U.S. Treasury securities turned negative and closed lower as they digested the Federal Reserve's first rate hike in more than two years and began to contemplate future monetary policy, analysts said.
Short-covering rallied the market right up to the Federal Open Market Committee's announcement, but a close reading of the Fed's policy statement knocked it down again, they said.
At 1700 EST/2200 GMT, the benchmark 30-year bond was off 17/32 at 95-23/32 to yield 6.97 percent. It had been up about half a point soon after the announcement.
